PROPOSED ONLY; same-session independent AI technical assessment, not human/organizational approval. Skipping a null/nonobject contributor drops that entry; it does not grant a principal or retain a verified signature. apiHelpers.ts:169-176 requires an array and skips malformed entries;177-185 validates/normalizes each retained address. apiHelpers.ts:207-228 verifies any nonempty supplied signature against its supplied payload and requires recovered signer to equal the contributor address;235 appends only a contributor metadata record. routes.ts:1640-1654 authenticates the request and authorizes its managed wallet before parseContributors at1683. Unsigned attribution is intentionally allowed and remains a claim. Contributor role/metadata strings are not authentication; consumers must not reinterpret them as authority. The signed payload is not shown here to be a job-scoped authorization token; this review refutes the reported gateway bypass only. Exact-source offline malformed-entry, valid/wrong signer, altered payload, missing payload, malformed signature and unsigned-metadata probes passed using real EIP191 verification.

PROPOSED ONLY; same-session independent AI technical assessment, not human/organizational approval. The optional-signature branch does not make an unsigned contributor authenticated. A signature field is emitted only after successful verification. apiHelpers.ts:205-207 tests whether an optional signature is a nonempty string;211-218 verifies its actual canonical payload, matches signer to normalized address, then stores signature and recomputed digest. apiHelpers.ts:226-233 rejects a supplied nonempty signature without payload; an unsigned payloadDigest is copied as self-asserted data, without signature. routes.ts:1640-1654 applies request authentication and managed-wallet authorization independently of contributor metadata. Missing/empty/nonstring contributor signatures follow the unsigned metadata path; that is not a validated contributor identity. Downstream systems must preserve the distinction. No user/organizational approval or acceptance of unsigned attribution is established by this review. Exact-source real-EIP191 contributor probes confirm invalid supplied proof refuses and unsigned attribution has no signature/principal.

PROPOSED ONLY; same-session independent AI technical assessment, not human/organizational approval. The early existence check is not the overwrite safety mechanism: the actual write atomically creates a new leaf using exclusive mode. four-repo-computer-lifecycle.cjs:184-188 takes operator-selected absolute input/source/output paths and checks evidence output is new and differs from input. four-repo-computer-lifecycle.cjs:532-535 writes with flag wx and mode0600; a preexisting regular leaf or leaf symlink makes O_EXCL fail instead of clobbering a target. four-repo-computer-lifecycle.cjs:152-162 prohibits external RPC/forks and requires disposable Hardhat31337;519-528 retains productionApproved:false and explicit scope limits. This does not prove immunity to parent-directory substitution or denial of service. Output ancestors must remain trusted/operator controlled. If an attacker can rename or replace those directories, an owner must assess that environment separately. The result is scoped to leaf overwrite/source evidence integrity, not a blanket filesystem-race certification. Independent child review against exact852: injecting a regular leaf or symlink between existsSync and writeFileSync produced EEXIST and preserved target bytes.
